statusDetail: A valid profile-faithful paired live Compare exists (de762740-subscription-harness-context-floor-live-20260915.json, 2026-09-15, terminalStatus valid, 3 pairs, all six runs exit 0 with usage present and deliveredPromptAttested true). It measures the AGENTS.md trim alone and it does not meet the material-reduction threshold: median total input fell 82560 -> 75682 (6878 tokens, 8.33 percent, below the 10 percent bar) and median uncached input rose 23552 -> 28834 (+5282 tokens, +22.43 percent) rather than falling. Acceptance evidence 2 is therefore measured and not met at n=3; it is no longer blocked on provider availability.

knownNonProductionProbe.limitation: The command omitted production project_doc_max_bytes=65536 and --cd; it is premise evidence, not a calibration.

materialReduction.threshold: at least 1000 tokens and 10 percent in both medians

codexCalibration.interpretation: Equal task content in both arms (identical promptSha256 and identical non-AGENTS.md inventory hashes), so the only varied input is AGENTS.md: 35532 bytes baseline versus 28069 bytes candidate. The trim moves median total input by about 8 percent and does not reduce uncached input at n=3. Run-to-run cache variance is large (baseline uncached spans 19207-36488 across the three pairs), so the uncached comparison at this sample size is not separable from cache-hit noise; it is reported as measured and not met, not as a measured regression.

liveAttemptsNote: Every paid Compare attempt made for this goal is listed below, valid or not, so that the calibration can be read together with what preceded it. The three 2026-09-02/03 attempts are invalid: Compare stops after the first invalid run instead of burning the remaining pairs, which is why their paidProcessStartedCount is 1 while pairs is 3. The 2026-09-15 attempt completed all six runs and is the calibration source above.

liveAttempts.outcome: All six runs completed with exit 0, usage present, and deliveredPromptAttested true. Baseline root was a clean copy of main a7a90387e with the same .scratch probe context; candidate root was the goal/de762740 worktree. This is the calibration source; the candidate does not meet the material threshold at n=3.

settledBy: Settled on 2026-09-15 by the paired live -Mode Compare receipt listed last in liveAttempts. Acceptance evidence 2 is now measured and not met for the AGENTS.md trim alone; re-opening it would require a different candidate (for example role-scoped autoload), not another run of this one.
